question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will logically complete the series.

_ F _ G E E _ E _ E E F _ G E E _ E G _
solution:
Given : _ F _ G E E _ E _ E E F _ G E E _ E G _ 

By checking options :

 
• EEFGEFE → __**E**__ F __**E**__ G E E __**F**__ E __**G**__ E E F __**E**__ G E E __**F**__ E G __**E**__ → (It follows the pattern of : EFEGE - EFEGE - EFEGE - EFEGE)
